card.fact_statement: Ahmed Mohamed Odowaa was slated for deportation to Italy on 5 April 2025.
card.source_span: On 5 April 2025, 30-year-old Somali national Ahmed Mohamed Odowaa, who had intervened when the two passersby were attacked and was one of three men who had chased down the perpetrator, was slated for deportation to Italy per the Dublin Regulation.
